implemented_scope: Native zero-fuse Instant placement/RNG/base initialization/synchronous detonation/normal manager retirement.
Delayed-fuse Instant without a live target uses the inherited base update.
Synchronous detonation accepts an initialized pending lifetime; it does not prematurely promote unrelated pending shots or fabricate an active body.
